item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: p=json.load(f)\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: rs=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nassert report == [evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]\\nr={'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'wrong','retry':True,'attempts':False}; rb=copy.deepcopy(r); pb=copy.deepcopy(p)\\nassert evaluate(r,p)=={'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}\\nassert r==rb and p==pb\\nassert evaluate({'from':'x','to':'y'},p)=={'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}\\nassert evaluate({'from':'failed','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':False},p)['reason']=='retry_limit'\\nassert evaluate({'from':'failed','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':-1},p)['reason']=='retry_limit'\\nassert evaluate({'from':'failed','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':2},p)['reason']=='retry_limit'\\nassert evaluate({'from':'failed','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':1},p)=={'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}"}
